summary: Phase 10 (Redirect-Inertness) dispatch: attempted blockedRedirect_boxctx_mem exactly as scoped by the plan (blockingWorldS4Keyed_eq_birthContent + S4LoopInv.keyLowerBd only, no extra hypotheses). Landed a scratch lemma with a trailing sorry, inspected the exact stuck goal via lean_goal, confirmed via lean_multi_attempt (aesop and simp_all [successorBirthContent, relevantSetFinset] both exhaust without closing), then FULLY REVERTED the scratch edit -- FrameSoundness.lean is byte-for-byte identical to its Phase-9 committed state (git diff --stat empty), no sorry or partial declaration left in place. Root cause: successorBirthContent (LoopChecking.lean:384) inserts only the unwrapped (Sign.pos, psi) pair for a T(box psi)@v on the branch, never the boxed (Sign.pos, box psi) pair; composed with keyLowerBd this yields only the unwrapped form T(psi)@wBlock, never the boxed form T(box psi)@wBlock that blockedRedirect_boxctx_mem's goal (and Phase 9's hready hypothesis) needs. The plan's own 'Named difficulty' clause anticipated exactly this failure mode ('if a world's recorded key genuinely does not entail the boxed form at that world, mark this phase [BLOCKED] and escalate with the exact goal state') and its assumption that 'S4 sends both psi and box psi forward' at mint time was checked against the actual modalApplyOne_boxNeg_mint_fst_S4/_diamondPos_mint_fst_S4 definitions and found false (they transmit only the unwrapped body; the boxed form is added later, by a separate 4-rule step, requiring an edge that in this case does not yet exist). Plan file Phase 10 heading marked [BLOCKED] with the full analysis (exact goal, root cause, and a concrete 'what would close it' proposal requiring a new S4LoopInv key-origin-edge invariant, out of this phase's 3.5-hour scope). Recommend /revise 553 to insert a new phase for that invariant before Phase 10 is re-attempted. No axiom count change (still 26), no new sorries, no code regression -- all Phases 1-9 declarations remain byte-for-byte unchanged.

blockers.verbatim_goal: Prove `blockedRedirect_boxctx_mem`: under mint-readiness (Phase 4's `_mintReady`), the guard's `some` case, and `S4LoopInv`, every `T(□ψ)@v ∈ b` has `T(□ψ)@wBlock ∈ b`.
blockers.what_was_tried: Stated the lemma with only blockingWorldS4Keyed_eq_birthContent + S4LoopInv.keyLowerBd as hypotheses (matching the plan's literal Obligation text), reduced to the goal `{ sign := Sign.pos, formula := □ψ, label := wBlock } ∈ b` from `hsub : successorBirthContent φ₀ b s φ v ⊆ relevantSetFinset φ₀ b wBlock`, and tried `aesop` and `simp_all [successorBirthContent, relevantSetFinset]` via lean_multi_attempt.
blockers.why_it_failed: successorBirthContent only ever inserts the unwrapped (Sign.pos, ψ) pair for a T(□ψ)@v member, never the boxed (Sign.pos, □ψ) pair, so hsub can only yield the unwrapped membership T(ψ)@wBlock, not the boxed T(□ψ)@wBlock the goal needs; both automation tactics exhaust without closing the gap.

decisions_made: Phase 4 deviation: modalStepBranchS4KeyedOrdered's shared per-formula body is factored into a new NAMED definition (modalStepBranchS4KeyedBody) rather than duplicated inline as the phase-4 handoff had sketched. modalStepBranchS4Keyed's own source is byte-for-byte unchanged; the bridge modalStepBranchS4Keyed_eq_findSome_body (rfl) relates the two. This made the three required structural lemmas provable against a named term instead of restating a six-way match inline in every statement.

Phase 4 deviation: modalStepBranchS4KeyedOrdered_mintReady's hypothesis is phrased as '∀ sf, body sf = tuple → mintShape sf = true' (universally quantified over every formula that could have produced the exact output tuple) rather than a single externally-supplied selected formula, since no cheap uniqueness argument establishes that only one formula in b can produce a given output tuple. This is the airtight, general form; verified sound via the shared _cases case split.

Phase 5 discovery (see phase-6 handoff for full writeup): a `let (a,b):=f x; body` pattern-match compiles to direct `.1`/`.2` PROJECTIONS when `f` is an ABSTRACT parameter (as modalStepBranchGen's `apply` is) but to a full `match` when `f` is a CONCRETE, already-known function (as in modalStepBranchS4KeyedBody). This determines which of two rewriting idioms applies to a given hypothesis, and caused two rounds of build-error debugging before the correct idiom was identified. This WILL recur in every one of Phase 6's ten sub-lemmas.

Phase 5 discovery: `Option.some.inj h` (raw term) + a bare-name `obtain ⟨rfl, name, -⟩` pattern lets rcases's internal substitution unify a free `newExp`-shaped variable with a branch-specific value the rest of a measure/invariant proof needs; pre-simplifying via `simp only [Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at h` first BLOCKS this unification and leaves the goal unsolvable.

Phase 5's projection bridge (modalStepBranchS4KeyedOrdered_proj) intentionally does NOT assert the ordered stepper's result equals modalStepBranchGen's own whole-branch findSome? traversal -- that would be FALSE in general. It instead extracts the weaker existential fact the measure proof actually consumes.

Phase 9 addition beyond the plan's literal task-list wording: `branchPropAdequateIn_s4FC_boxPos_trans_mem`/`_diaNeg_trans_mem` and `branchPropAdequateIn_boxPos_mem` each carry an explicit `hready` hypothesis. Justification: branchPropAdequateIn's edge conjunct is branch-content-driven (unlike branchSatisfiableIn's), so adding a new box/diamond-shaped formula reopens the conjunct's obligation at w''s existing outgoing edges; the hypothesis-free analogue is false for an unconstrained acc. hready is exactly what Phase 4's mint-readiness discipline guarantees at real call sites, and its redirect-edge discharge is precisely Phase 10's stated goal.

Phase 9's modalClosed_unsat_propAdequateIn cannot delegate to the existing modalClosed_unsat; resolved via direct transcription of its tactic script against branchPropAdequateIn's own (identically-shaped) branch-formula conjunct.

Phase 10 dispatch: verified empirically (lean_goal + lean_multi_attempt), not merely by inspection, that blockedRedirect_boxctx_mem's stated obligation is unprovable from blockingWorldS4Keyed_eq_birthContent + S4LoopInv.keyLowerBd alone. Decided this is a genuine mathematical gap (the plan's 'Named difficulty' contingency), not an automation gap, and reverted the scratch attempt rather than leave a non-strategic sorry in place. Identified a concrete, structurally-motivated fix (a new S4LoopInv key-origin-edge invariant) but judged it out of scope for this phase's stated 3.5-hour budget and recommended a plan revision instead of silently expanding scope.
